sloka: स राक्षसानां निहतं महद्बलं निशम्य राजा परिवृत्तलोचनः ।समादिदेशाप्रतिमं पराक्रमे प्रहस्त पुत्रं समरे सुदुर्जयम् ।। ५.४२.४३।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasānāṁ nihataṁ mahadbalaṁ niśamya rājā parivṛttalocanaḥ ।samādideśāpratimaṁ parākrame prahasta putraṁ samare sudurjayam ।। 5.42.43।।

translations.english: The mighty demon king having heard about the killing of the formidable army of ogres, his eyes rolling in rage, commanded the son of Prahasta, who is difficult to conquer and matchless in war. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
